name: partner-analytics-commercial-readback
executionConcern: Partner-scoped operational analytics and commercial-model readback without turning analytics into truth or local financial calculation
objective: Keep Partner performance and commercial summaries correctly scoped, provenance/freshness-aware read models sourced from canonical DSH/WLT facts, eliminate the selected-Store analytics ambiguity, and preserve compatible operator analytics without fabricated zero or success states.
truthOwner: DSH owns operational facts and operational analytics projections; WLT owns financial facts/projections. Analytics/read models never own underlying truth.

tasks.objective: Resolve selected-Store Partner analytics contract mismatch
tasks.currentProblem: PartnerAnalyticsInsightsPanel receives canonicalStoreId and labels metrics as Store-scoped, while fetchPartnerPerformance sends period only and backend handlePartnerPerformance resolves a Store independently through partnerStore.
tasks.requiredChange: Choose and implement one canonical semantic: either add selected Store intent to the analytics contract with server-side Partner/Store authorization, or make the endpoint explicitly Partner-wide and change UI/read-model semantics accordingly; update OpenAPI/generated clients/tests as required.
tasks.targetState: For a Partner with multiple Stores, every displayed performance metric unambiguously describes the authorized selected Store or an explicitly labeled Partner-wide aggregation, with no client-trusted authorization.
tasks.action: Fix the contract/backend semantic owner first, regenerate/migrate affected consumers, then update Partner/operator presentation and rerun linked checks.
mustNotChange: Do not trust arbitrary client Store IDs as authorization.
Do not silently aggregate multiple Stores while labeling one selected Store.
Do not turn analytics into an operational or financial writer.
Do not broaden unrelated platform analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-Store Partner analytics semantics are explicit and server-authorized.
Unauthorized Store intent fails closed without cross-Store disclosure.
Partner/operator consumers remain contract-compatible after any operation change.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused analytics contract/consumer changes or roll forward while preserving canonical DSH operational facts; never retain ambiguous Store semantics.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U008 implementation commit after contract/backend semantics, generated consumers and Partner/operator readback align.

tasks.objective: Close metric provenance, freshness and commercial/financial readback behavior
tasks.currentProblem: Read models can mislead if missing/stale/partial facts render as zero or if commercial/financial values are locally derived without source/time/currency semantics.
tasks.requiredChange: Ensure Partner analytics/commercial presentation exposes applicable loading/empty/partial/offline/error/freshness states and derives financial figures only from WLT-backed projections; align operator compatible metrics without creating another owner.
tasks.targetState: Every displayed metric has canonical source/window/freshness semantics and missing/stale data is explicit rather than fabricated.
tasks.action: Change only Partner/commercial/shared analytics and directly compatible operator consumers; preserve underlying DSH/WLT truth ownership.
mustNotChange: Do not render missing/stale financial data as zero.
Do not calculate authoritative wallet/settlement values in DSH/frontend.
Do not mutate operational state from analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Financial metrics use WLT-backed values with currency/unit semantics.
Analytics remains a read model and compatible operator readback remains correct.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation/read-model changes without changing underlying DSH/WLT facts.
